resolved_issues.description: The earlier small event and anniversary bottom captures showed a random multicolour square before the More settings label. QIconEngine needed an explicit transparent pixmap implementation.
resolved_issues.resolution: DisclosureIcon.pixmap initializes QPixmap with Qt.transparent, then paints the vector chevron. Parent-authorized local fix; four icon sizes tested for transparent edges, meaningful painted area and deterministic rendering.

method: Every PNG listed by each completed report.json was visually reviewed in contact sheets. Eight refreshed editor frames per group were included or re-reviewed after recapture. Four representative arrow originals were additionally reviewed at original resolution. Existing scroll viewport crop at a scrolled boundary is expected; fixed dialog actions remain visible.
checks: static upcoming-arrangements label versus reminder-period action
editable event and anniversary cards and advance checkboxes
inline validation error and invalid-name focus
